title: Plasma compression fusion device paper cited in China and IEEE Cybernetics

tellings.quote: no however there's a paper out there plasma compression fusion device you and I were talking right before uh it's being cited by some very important and uh research teams in China and the latest that's being start cited is of this year I e journal cybernetics

plain: Salvatore Pais, a US Navy scientist with patents on unusual craft designs, says one of his papers, on a plasma compression fusion device, a machine meant to make energy by squeezing superhot gas until atoms fuse, is being cited by important research teams in China. He adds that this year it was cited in a journal on cybernetics from the IEEE, a large international engineering society. He tells it to show his ideas are being taken seriously by scientists abroad.
